paper.title: Algorithm 733: TOMP - Fortran modules for optimal control calculations (test driver)

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 733, single file 733.f with the TOMP modules and the unnamed test driver)

claim.text: Final cost of the constrained brachistochrone test driver, iteration 27, 1.7952392, tol_abs 1e-5 (shipped TOMP.OUT block, 733.f lines 77-109)

attempt: Measured in the sandbox, two passes, the same recipe. Each pass copies the unpacked archive, extracts lines 556 to the end of 733.f into TOMP.FOR (a verbatim copy, byte-equal to the range; the range hash is in patch.extraction and evidence/source-range.f), and compiles with gfortran -std=legacy -w -o tomp TOMP.FOR. Pass 1 final cost 1.7952392 (iteration 27, constraint violation 0.8371D-06); pass 2 1.7952392. Shipped TOMP.OUT: 0.17952392D+01. Difference 0 at the printed precision, inside tol_abs 1e-5. The archive as shipped does not compile (lines 1-555 are unmarked prose and MATLAB data), so the basis is patched. Archive sha256 cf49f88ca0138f774b7cabda7acd85f0e1c2d36cbc263eebb5d029f69e794c35.

original_attempt.reason: 733.f as shipped does not compile: gfortran stops at line 4 ('Non-numeric character in statement label') on the unmarked archive prose; also 'Coarrays disabled' at line 28 once the prose is past. Earlier manual passes were run outside the sandbox and are kept in evidence/manual-prior-run (superseded; not used for the value).
